g.text: Codec uses Y2 12.288 MHz MCLK without PLL: SYSCLK=256fs.

g.desc: Codec uses Y2 12.288 MHz MCLK without PLL: SYSCLK=256fs.

g.text: 48 kHz LRCLK; 3.072 MHz BCLK; 32-bit slots / 16-bit samples.

g.desc: 48 kHz LRCLK; 3.072 MHz BCLK; 32-bit slots / 16-bit samples.

g.text: SAMD21 I2S clock unit 0 is client; R75/R76 near codec outputs.

g.desc: SAMD21 I2S clock unit 0 is client; R75/R76 near codec outputs.

g.text: USB input: R78 = 61.9k / 1%; current limit about 425 mA

g.desc: USB input: R78 = 61.9k / 1%; current limit about 425 mA

g.text: C105 = 1uF directly on VBUS; output capacitors after soft start.

g.desc: C105 = 1uF directly on VBUS; output capacitors after soft start.

g.text: Layout: C106/C107 at AVDD; AVDD connects directly to 3V3.

g.desc: Layout: C106/C107 at AVDD; AVDD connects directly to 3V3.

g.text: Use one continuous ground plane. Keep clock/USB away

g.desc: Use one continuous ground plane. Keep clock/USB away

g.text: from microphone input; route HP returns away from MIC.

g.desc: from microphone input; route HP returns away from MIC.

g.text: Firmware: check SAMD21 silicon revision (C/D/H); apply DS80000760 errata.

g.desc: Firmware: check SAMD21 silicon revision (C/D/H); apply DS80000760 errata.

g.text: USB async audio needs feedback + DMA buffering; no firmware supplied.

g.desc: USB async audio needs feedback + DMA buffering; no firmware supplied.

g.text: Keep speaker off before USB configuration; total continuous load <=350 mA

g.desc: Keep speaker off before USB configuration; total continuous load <=350 mA

g.text: and within the USB host power budget. Verify suspend current on hardware.

g.desc: and within the USB host power budget. Verify suspend current on hardware.

g.text: SAMD21E18A + WM8978 | USB full-duplex audio | 48 kHz / 16-bit

g.desc: SAMD21E18A + WM8978 | USB full-duplex audio | 48 kHz / 16-bit

g.text: Continuous signal wiring; labels are annotations. Power/ground use conventional symbols.

g.desc: Continuous signal wiring; labels are annotations. Power/ground use conventional symbols.

g.text: Boot OSC8M -> PA18 high -> wait >=2 ms -> select 12 MHz XOSC external clock.

g.desc: Boot OSC8M -> PA18 high -> wait >=2 ms -> select 12 MHz XOSC external clock.

g.text: Y1 clocks MCU/USB; Y2 12.288 MHz clocks codec only. Codec is I2S master.

g.desc: Y1 clocks MCU/USB; Y2 12.288 MHz clocks codec only. Codec is I2S master.

g.text: USB and audio clocks are asynchronous: use feedback + DMA buffering.

g.desc: USB and audio clocks are asynchronous: use feedback + DMA buffering.

g.text: Before suspend: mute audio, return MCU to internal clock, then disable Y1/Y2.

g.desc: Before suspend: mute audio, return MCU to internal clock, then disable Y1/Y2.

g.text: 4-wire SWD; no external reset connection. Power-cycle if needed.

g.desc: 4-wire SWD; no external reset connection. Power-cycle if needed.

g.text: 8 mm can diameter; positive terminal toward codec.

g.desc: 8 mm can diameter; positive terminal toward codec.

g.text: SPK2 is BTL: neither terminal connects to ground.

g.desc: SPK2 is BTL: neither terminal connects to ground.
